_meta.method: OSCR: downloaded the full Scottish Charity Register from https://www.oscr.org.uk/download/charity-register (linked from /about-charities/search-the-register/download-the-scottish-charity-register/; HTTP 200, zip CharityExport-11-Oct-2026.csv, 24952 rows), read the CSV from the zip without extracting, matched 'Charity Number' exactly; cross-checked each charity's page /about-charities/search-the-register/charity-details?number=<SC> (HTTP 200, same name/status). CCNI: the site's charity search JSON API (/api/charity-search/results?homePageId=...&searchText=<number>, found in the page's widget config and apps-module.js), the details page /charity-search/charity-details-page/?regId=<n>&subId=0 and its 'Export to CSV' (/api/charity-details/exportToCsv?regId=<n>&subId=0), all HTTP 200; for 100770 also the 2025 accounts PDF linked from the details page (scanned image, cover and company-information pages read visually). Companies House: public pages (/company/<n>, /search/companies?q=, /alphabetical-search/get-results?companyName=) at >=1.5 s per request, pattern from 448-campaign/ch_fetch.py.
